reviewer: Codex /root: source, multilingual editorial and synthetic artifact review
review_scope: Replaces the assessment-only outline with five localized resumable construction chapters and a separate financial lab. Read current specialist skill, native contract, intake, exports and adapters. Inspected original fictional inputs, localized Word/PDF/Markdown content, registers, snapshots, financial rows and KPI history. Rendered Italian course and chapter and English course in the Codex browser; visually inspected all pages of a generated manual. The PDF exporter may orphan its final version line on a second page; this remains a disclosed pre-existing export limitation, not a claim of client-ready layout. Fixed export headings are Italian and some test attribution/engineering labels are English. Native voice, window arrangement, learner participation/understanding, authenticated professional approval and real-company operating effectiveness are not established. Technical tests manufacture separately receipted synthetic decisions only at execution time; no approved case, approval or result is shipped as a teaching input. The 390-second metadata describes the introductory lesson; extended construction and financial labs require further resumable sessions.

editorial.purpose_and_first_use: The localized title teaches both assessment and construction in the same engagement. Officina Arco has twelve staff and one site. Retains the original March assessment and April chronology; construction begins from an attributed discovery visit and one scoped monthly-close control.
editorial.inputs_and_request: Read all it outline fields and construction, construction-update and financial-lab chapters, plus company/procedure/February operation/April update. Shared JSON contains unapproved raw fictional facts, no case model, mapping, plan output or professional approvals. Financial-lab entity is explicitly separate from Officina Arco and the existing Ciclo Arco lesson.
editorial.execution_and_checkpoints: Current native assessment tests pass separately. New native CLI checks import exact kit bytes in a genuine local archive, open the case/form, export/import Markdown, finalize and resume a snapshot with every original source, qualify evidence, compare unknown/base/override, and retain evidence-finding-control-action links. Checkpoints ask the real learner to trace evidence; no learner answers are manufactured in the lesson.
editorial.deliverable_and_next_action: Inspected actual localized control prose in DOCX/PDF/Markdown, the editable register, JSON/hash manifest and construction snapshots. Draft, test-only attributed professional review, adoption and simulated execution are separate states; producing/reviewing the manual does not change evidence scores. Simulation remains design_only with A1 open. Italian fixed headings and the final PDF version-line pagination limit are explicit.
editorial.practice_and_repeat: Distinct practice resumes the same engagement with April evidence, stales the exact qualification and recorded override, changes the control, retains M1 and compiles draft M2 without transferring approval. The original KPI observation remains immutable after population/formula version changes. A separate native v3 financial lab rejects unreviewed/partial plans and unreconciled totals, preserves Budget -100 and Forecast -150, and rejects stale financial narrative before re-authoring it.
editorial.language_and_pacing: Language it: complete outline, discovery chapter, practice and lab translated with the same facts; jurisdiction remains Italy. The ordinary introductory outline uses six stages totaling 390 seconds; construction and finance continue in further resumable sessions. Do not treat this as a measured end-to-end lesson duration. Business Planning’s separate Ciclo Arco kit supports it/en; the current teacher explains those sources in their actual language. Fixed construction-export headings remain Italian, with engineering test labels explicitly outside learner-facing copy.
